name: Burrflog
description: Open with a plain downward cut of the spiked head, keeping the shaft long and the feet shoulder-wide.

name: Rooted Shaftcollar
description: Knock an incoming thrust aside with the middle of the shaft and keep the ball hanging for the reply.

name: Ballglide
description: Drag the lead foot forward a short pace behind the ball's swing to close the distance.

name: Pummelslap
description: Swing the orb in a flat circle at waist height so the studs reach the opponent's flank.

name: Pummelflog
description: Send a thin stream of qi down the shaft at the instant of impact so the falling head hits far heavier.

name: Clutching Topspike
description: Hook a spike on the enemy's weapon guard and roll the shaft over it, locking the blade against his body.

name: Crunchslap
description: Cut a clean arc with the burr head from shoulder to hip so the bristles rake along the target.

name: Sturdy Spikering
description: Raise the haft level before the face so a cut lands on the wood between the hands.

name: Cruel Thornbite
description: Jab the burr head forward on a shortened grip so one stud pricks through a gap in the padding.

name: Burrzip
description: Slide a pace to the side while the ball continues its swing, putting the user off the foe's line.

name: Maulthwack
description: Let the swung head rebound off the target and carry it round for a second swing from the other side.

name: Maulswat
description: Carry steady qi along the shaft into the burr head throughout a long swing, so the bristles bite harder as it falls.

name: Guarding Headspike
description: Hook the burr head over the top of an enemy's blade and turn the whole shaft to drag the weapon aside.

name: Ballscorer
description: Breathe out sharply as the head drops, letting the exhale drive the arms through the final foot.

name: Padded Prickball
description: Weave the shaft in a small figure across the front to turn aside a series of quick thrusts.

name: Thistleswerve
description: Advance by rolling from heel to toe so the swing never loses its balance.

name: Rough Studball
description: Knock the head sideways against the ribs under a lifted arm, spikes biting through the cloth.

name: Dense Ballsocket
description: Whip the head back over the shoulder after a strike so the shaft crosses the body again at once.

name: Thistleflog
description: Use the final rising arc of a swing to bring the head down hard onto a bare crown.

name: Crunchscorer
description: Time a held breath so that qi collects in the arms and bursts into the head at the moment of impact.

name: Gagging Thornball
description: After a body blow that empties the foe's lungs, press the shaft across his chest and lean to hold him down.

name: Wild Topspike
description: Lift the thorned head behind the shoulder and swing it overhand in a single heavy arc.

name: Dire Spikebase
description: Bring the thorned head across the body and backhand it outward so it strikes on the return.

name: Stalwart Shaftcollar
description: Plant the capped end of the haft in the ground and brace behind it while the ball hangs ready.

name: Veering Crunch
description: Shuffle both feet together in short bursts, keeping the body low under the swinging head.

name: Lassoing Spikering
description: Snag the thorns in the collar of the foe's coat and haul back to throw him off his stance.

name: Ballswat
description: Thump the capped butt of the shaft into the belly of a foe who steps inside the arc.

name: Crunchswat
description: Pour qi into a falling overhead stroke so the thorned head comes down heavy enough to buckle a raised guard.

name: Cinder Studcrush
description: Sweep the thorned head across low in a wide ring to catch every leg in reach.

name: Layered Spikebase
description: Stretch a thin sheet of qi along the shaft and hold the haft across the body to stop a heavy cut.

name: Rude Headspike
description: Drop the bristled orb straight onto a target from shoulder height, again and again, to set the line.

name: Burrthwack
description: Cut across the front on a slant so the bristles sweep from the opponent's shoulder to his hip.

name: Resolute Prickball
description: Bring the orb back to the front and use the shaft just behind it to catch a descending blow.

name: Springing Spikedrop
description: Skip forward on the toes just ahead of the swing so the strike meets the foe at full reach.

name: Shard Thornbite
description: Lunge with the leading stud of the orb aimed at a joint in the armor and push in with both arms.

name: Buttressed Ballsocket
description: Rise onto the lead foot and lift the haft up and across to slap a thrust away from the face.

name: Burrslap
description: Spin the orb once around the wrist after a blow, then bring it back into line for another stroke.

name: Ember Maul
description: Flare qi into the bristles at the moment of contact so every stud lands as a separate hard point.

name: Braided Pummel
description: Link three strokes of the orb in one unbroken round, each step carrying the swing into the next.

name: Binding Spikeball
description: Sink the leading spike into a plank shield and hold it there with qi in the haft while the wielder circles round.

name: Doughty Thornball
description: Choose the landing point before the swing begins and bring the barbed head to that exact spot.

name: Armored Topspike
description: Halt a swing mid-arc by pulling the shaft to the chest, leaving the barbs hovering as a guard.

name: Ballhurdle
description: Walk forward along a straight line with the head swinging in small controlled loops.

name: Ballslap
description: Flick the wrists to snap the barbed head a short distance forward into a face or hand.

name: Stubborn Spikebase
description: Loop the head in a small circle after a strike, knocking aside a counterthrust on the way back.

name: Acrid Prickball
description: Run a thread of qi to the barbed head and use it to correct the landing point in mid-swing.

name: Entangling Headspike
description: Stop the head short with a flash of qi in the shaft and snap it back so a charging foe runs onto it.

name: Harsh Studball
description: Make the rear hand the fulcrum and swing the head with the lead hand, lengthening the stroke.

name: Rigid Shaftcollar
description: Angle the shaft against the ground and the shoulder so it braces like a lever against a charge.

name: Slinking Maul
description: Rock the weight between the feet with the shaft acting as a staff, shifting position without lifting the head.

name: Levering Topspike
description: Set a spike under the rim of a helm and lever the shaft to wrench the head sideways.

name: Thistlethwack
description: Swing the head low with the lever grip so it thumps into the thigh at the full length of reach.

name: Unmoving Ballsocket
description: Hold the shaft against the shoulder and rock it back to turn aside a stab at the chest.

name: Brass Spikering
description: Lean on the shaft and push qi into a single spike so it bites through plate where a blow would glance.

name: Tethering Thornbite
description: Keep a spike lodged in armor and wrench the shaft with qi-backed leverage to hold the foe in place.

name: Savage Prickball
description: Begin the round with a plain drop of the head, already turning the hips to follow it through.

name: Sturdy Headspike
description: Turn the shaft in a slow circle before the chest so the rolling haft stops lighter blows.

name: Prowling Crunch
description: Shift one pace around the foe in the direction the head is already travelling.

name: Maulflog
description: Let the head pass close by the opponent's side so the spikes score him as it goes round.

name: Pummelthwack
description: Close the round with a hard rap of the head on the same spot hit in the opening drop.

name: Rooted Spikebase
description: Cover the open side with the haft as the head completes its turn, catching a thrust meant for the ribs.

name: Brawn Spikeball
description: Feed a fresh breath of qi into the head at each turn of the round so its strikes never weaken.

name: Grit Thornball
description: Whirl the head in a steady level circle round the body so every attacker in reach is struck.

name: Stalling Headspike
description: Halt the spinning head against an enemy's weapon and snag it on a spike, pulling the weapon away from the foe's grip.
